mechanics.claim: Pyke's maximum health cannot increase except through growth (per level).
mechanics.quote: '''Pyke's''' {{sti|health|{{as|'''maximum''' health}}}} cannot increase except through [[Growth#Increasing_Statistics|growth (per level)]]

mechanics.claim: Grey health is gained only from post-mitigation damage taken from enemy champions.
mechanics.quote: '''Pyke''' stores [[Health#Grey health|grey health]] when receiving damage from enemy {{tip|champions}}, increased if there are multiple nearby.

mechanics.claim: Grey health is consumed to heal Pyke only while he is not visible to enemies.
mechanics.quote: While '''Pyke''' is not {{tip|sight|visible}} to enemies, he rapidly consumes his [[Health#Grey health|grey health]] to {{tip|heal}} for the same amount.

mechanics.claim: Grey health has no time limit and persists until Pyke leaves enemy vision or dies.
mechanics.quote: '''Pyke's''' ''grey health'' does not have a time limit, and will stay on his {{as|health bar}} until '''Pyke''' leaves enemy vision or dies.

mechanics.claim: If current health plus grey health would exceed maximum health, the excess grey health is lost.
mechanics.quote: if his combined {{as|'''current''' health}} and ''grey health'' would start to exceed {{as|100% of his '''maximum''' health}}, the excess ''grey health'' is lost

mechanics.claim: Spirit Visage and Grievous Wounds apply their reductions after the grey-health healing cap is applied.
mechanics.quote: {{ii|Spirit Visage}} and {{tip|Grievous Wounds}} take effect after ''Gift of the Drowned Ones's'' healing cap.
